description:
Return counted Plainrouter arrivals beside daily Meta metrics for mirrored campaigns, ad sets and ads. object_metrics contains account-timezone daily comparisons; unmatched_arrivals is one workspace/window count without unknown IDs. Counts are null when the arrivals store is disabled. Optional change history shows who changed what, and whether it came through Plainrouter, within plan retention. Coverage states where records start, which Meta days may change, missing reads, untagged spend and the kept window. Optional revisions list what Meta changed on days already read in full, with the old and new account totals.
basis_note explains how the two counts differ.

account_id.description: Advertising account ID available to the authorized workspace.

ad_id.description: Limit metrics to this ad ID.

adset_id.description: Limit metrics to this ad set ID.

campaign_id.description: Limit metrics to this campaign ID.

cursor.description: Continue all four collections using next_cursor with the same filters and include_changes.

end_date.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

include_changes.description: Include object diffs and account activities: who changed what, and whether it came through Plainrouter.

include_revisions.description: Include revisions: what Meta changed on days already read in full, as old and new account totals per day. Object filters do not narrow it, and it does not use the cursor.

limit.description: Maximum rows per collection; byte budgets may return fewer.

start_date.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_inventory_metrics

coverage.description: What this Attribution answer covers: kept history, record starts, revisable Meta days, unread days and unknown spend.

kept_from.description: The read retention boundary as a date in timezone; inventory uses its first fully retained local day.

account_id.description: The authorized advertising account this Meta block describes.

other_account_ids.description: Other authorized accounts included in the answer but not described by this Meta coverage.

revisable.description: Inclusive local days Meta can still revise, floored by this read cutoff.

unread_days.description: Unread local days inside this answer range; at most 31 dates, with the full count. A read must occur after next local midnight plus ten minutes.

untagged_spend.description: A separate seven-complete-local-day window, independent of the answer range.

basis_points.description: Spend not fully tagged; null means unknown, never zero.

not_recorded.description: Stripe limitations only when this read includes revenue.

counted.description: First available kept record; a null date has a reason. Counted and revenue dates use UTC; Meta dates use the account timezone.

meta_changes.description: First available kept record; a null date has a reason. Counted and revenue dates use UTC; Meta dates use the account timezone.

meta_spend.description: First available kept record; a null date has a reason. Counted and revenue dates use UTC; Meta dates use the account timezone.

revenue.description: Earliest stored webhook or active connection start in UTC, only for reads including revenue; null without an active key connection or configured webhook, and a reason explains clamping to the kept window.

timezone.description: Meta account timezone, or UTC without an account.

revisions.description: Only with include_revisions. What Meta changed on days already read in full, newest first: one row each time a later read changed the account totals of a day whose earlier read was made after next local midnight plus ten minutes. A day still filling up, a first read and an unchanged read are never listed. Changes made before Plainrouter began recording them are not listed. revised_at and previous_read_at are when each read started; when an older read finishes after a newer one, revised_at is earlier than previous_read_at, and that row and the next one for the day reflect the late read, not a change by Meta. At most 100 rows and never more than the page has room for; a shorter date range or a smaller limit shows the rest.

capped.description: True when rows holds fewer revisions than count.

count.description: All kept revisions in the answer range, including rows not returned.

date.description: The revised day in the account timezone.

new.description: Account totals for the day across every ad.

purchase_value.description: Meta pixel purchase value in major units of account_currency.

purchases.description: Meta pixel purchases as a decimal string.

old.description: Account totals for the day across every ad.

purchase_value.description: Meta pixel purchase value in major units of account_currency.

purchases.description: Meta pixel purchases as a decimal string.

previous_read_at.description: When the read that produced the old totals started, in UTC.

revised_at.description: When the read that changed the stored totals started, in UTC.

title: Get inventory metrics
